summary: The 2026 LLM landscape is dominated by frontier proprietary models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google, which reach most enterprises through cloud aggregators like AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, and Google Vertex AI rather than direct APIs. Open-weight challengers from DeepSeek, Meta, Qwen, and Mistral have narrowed the capability gap dramatically while undercutting on price, driving massive HuggingFace download volume. Cost-per-performance has collapsed roughly 10x year-over-year, with cheaper flagship and 'flash/mini' tiers now handling the bulk of production traffic.

models.name: GPT-6
models.popularity_notes: Cited as the market-leading model as of October 2026 and available broadly through Azure OpenAI Service, giving it enormous enterprise aggregator reach on top of direct API volume.
models.best_for: General-purpose production applications requiring top-tier reasoning and enterprise-grade deployment

models.name: Claude Opus 5.5
models.popularity_notes: Named a market leader in October 2026 and distributed via AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, and Snowflake Cortex, making it a default choice for coding-heavy enterprise workloads.
models.best_for: Complex software engineering and agentic coding tasks in regulated enterprises

models.name: Gemini 4 Argon
models.popularity_notes: Listed as a leading model in October 2026 with native distribution through Google Vertex AI and tight Google Cloud/Workspace integration driving large enterprise adoption.
models.best_for: Multimodal and long-context applications needing large document or video understanding

models.name: Gemini 3.1 Flash
models.popularity_notes: The high-volume workhorse tier offering a 1M token context at roughly $0.25 per million input tokens, making it one of the most-used models for cost-sensitive production traffic via Vertex AI.
models.best_for: High-volume, latency-sensitive production workloads at low cost

models.name: DeepSeek V3.2
models.popularity_notes: Cited as delivering roughly 90% of GPT-5.4 performance at 1/50th the cost, driving huge open-weight HuggingFace download volume and self-hosted adoption.
models.best_for: Cost-efficient reasoning and coding at scale with on-prem or self-hosted deployment

models.name: DeepSeek R1
models.popularity_notes: A 671B-parameter MoE (37B active) reasoning specialist priced around $0.55/$2.19 per million tokens with massive open-weights download adoption among developers.
models.best_for: Reasoning-heavy and algorithmic tasks where open-weight control matters

models.name: Qwen3.8
models.popularity_notes: Highlighted as a leading new open model in October 2026, Qwen's series consistently ranks among the top HuggingFace downloads and powers extensive fine-tuning ecosystems.
models.best_for: Multilingual applications and custom fine-tuned open-weight deployments

models.name: Llama (Meta Muse Spark Open)
models.popularity_notes: Meta's open model, cited as a leading new open release in October 2026, benefits from Meta's massive open-weight distribution footprint and availability on AWS Bedrock and Azure.
models.best_for: Open-weight production deployments needing broad ecosystem and aggregator support

models.name: Mistral Large 4
models.popularity_notes: Europe's flagship cited in October 2026, available through AWS Bedrock and Azure AI with strong adoption among EU enterprises prioritizing data sovereignty.
models.best_for: European enterprises needing GDPR-aligned, data-sovereign LLM deployments

models.name: DeepSeek V4
models.popularity_notes: Listed as a leading new open model in October 2026, extending DeepSeek's strong cost-performance reputation and driving continued high open-weights adoption.
models.best_for: Latest-generation open-weight reasoning at minimal cost
